items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: So I told the guy that night that I'm working for, Babe Burton

ctx.x: Well, I'll tell you the truth, I didn't drink a thing. People couldn't understand. They said, "I've never seen a musician that didn't drink." People would come in the clubs and would want to buy me a drink, you know, I just didn't drink and people didn't -- you know, they just couldn't understand it. So finally, I met some girl, you know, there in Arkansas City, and so-she told me, "I want to invite you to a party." She says, "But now, when you come to the party, the party will start about the time after you all…

So I told the guy that night that I'm working for, Babe Burton, I says, "Look, I'm supposed to go to a party. They want me to bring some whiskey. What would you suggest?" He said, "Well, I got some Four Roses here." And that sounded good to me, Four Roses. Oh, I said, "Four Roses?"
